hospital: Health plans and providers covered by the No Surprises Act
title: 45 CFR 149.410(a), emergency services

emergency-cost-sharing.quote: A nonparticipating emergency facility must not bill, and must not hold liable, the participant, beneficiary, or enrollee for a payment amount for such emergency services

emergency-provider.quote: A nonparticipating provider must not bill, and must not hold liable, the participant, beneficiary, or enrollee for a payment amount for an emergency service
